description: Agent-readiness acceptance tasks. Each task is a verifiable check a coding agent's change must keep green; pass-rate is the headline metric. Commands are argv arrays run from the repo root with no shell.

tasks.description: Every path referenced in context/docs resolves (no hallucinated paths).
No layer below ml/ imports from ticket_price_predictor.ml (split-before-fit invariant).
command: import pathlib,sys; root=pathlib.Path('src/ticket_price_predictor'); layers=['schemas','storage','scrapers','normalization','preprocessing','validation','api','popularity','ingestion']; bad=[str(f) for L in layers for f in (root/L).rglob('*.py') if 'ticket_price_predictor.ml' in f.read_text()]; print('\n'.join(bad)); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

tasks.description: Core preprocessing source compiles without syntax errors.
docs/issues/README.md indexes every numbered issue entry.
command: import pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path('docs/issues'); idx=p/'README.md'; ids=[f.name for f in p.glob('[0-9]*.md')]; txt=idx.read_text() if idx.exists() else ''; missing=[i for i in ids if i not in txt]; print('missing:', missing); sys.exit(1 if (not idx.exists() or missing) else 0)

tasks.description: Root MEMORY.md links the decision store (docs/issues).
command: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('MEMORY.md').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if 'docs/issues' in t else 1)

tasks.description: A visual dependency/data-flow diagram (mermaid) exists in the agent-facing docs.
command: import pathlib,sys; t=pathlib.Path('CLAUDE.md').read_text()+pathlib.Path('docs/ARCHITECTURE.md').read_text(); sys.exit(0 if '```mermaid' in t else 1)
